text:
maria: FYI getting sporadic mTLS failures from apac->edge after last night's STS role refactor. ~6% handshakes failing.
hugo: logs show `crypto: keystore unwrap failed` and KMS AccessDenied in the same window.
kms-bot: 2026-04-02T02:12:15Z KMS AccessDenied Decrypt key=arn:aws:kms:apac:123:key/mtls-ca principal=assumed-role/rotator-staging
sec-oncall: could this be an IAM policy timing issue from the role rename? Did we rotate role ARNs across nodes?
maria: we changed `rotator` -> `rotator-staging` in infra at 01:50Z. Most nodes got updated, a few had old agent still binding to previous role name.
hugo: find in rotator logs: `2026-04-02T02:11:58Z rotator: WARN assume-role failed: InvalidIdentityToken` then `2026-04-02T02:12:01Z rotator: ERROR kms:Decrypt AccessDenied`.
sec-oncall: so STS assume failures then KMS denies -> handshake fails. Quick mitigation: create a temporary Grant for the old principal so nodes with lagging rollout can still decrypt. Is that safe?
maria: yes, `aws kms create-grant --key-id <id> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/rotator --operations Decrypt --name rotator-compat` should restore traffic.
kms-bot: grant created at 2026-04-02T02:16:02Z id=gr-zz11. Post-grant, handshake error rate dropped to 0.9% within 40s.
hugo: follow-ups: 1) make rotator credential refresh robust to role rename 2) add preflight in rollout that verifies STS assume for new role on each node 3) prefer Grants in rotation scripts to avoid short windows of deny.
sec-oncall: compliance: capture CloudTrail AccessDenied events, CreateGrant event, and save as artifact. Also schedule a policy review to remove the temporary grant once rollout completed.
maria: I'll revoke the grant after confirming all nodes report `rotator_role=rotator-staging`. Planning revoke at 02:40Z.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started by maria at 2026-04-02T02:05:00Z -> 4/6 nodes updated.
sec-oncall: documenting incident SEC-2026-311, status: mitigated -> monitoring. cc @compliance https://internal.corp/audit/2790001234
maria: revoking temp grant now. `aws kms retire-grant --grant-id gr-zz11 --key-id <id>`
kms-bot: grant gr-zz11 retired at 2026-04-02T02:42:10Z. Monitoring stable.
sec-oncall: action items: add CI check: for every role rename, run `sts:AssumeRole` test and create ephemeral Grant if there is rollout lag; add `rotator_credential_age_seconds` metric. Assign owners: hugo (code), maria (runbook), sec-oncall (audit). End thread.
